Supplementary Data Set 1: Genes Differentially Expressed in Autistic Cortex

Source: R/dataset.s1.R
dataset.s1.Rd

Genes differentially expressed (up- and down-regulated) in the cortex of autistic versus control subjects, from human transcriptomic data (Voineagu et al. 2011).

Usage

dataset.s1

Format

A list of two character vectors of gene symbols:

up.regulated

up-regulated genes (N = 234)

down.regulated

down-regulated genes (N = 229)

Source

Voineagu I, Wang X, Johnston P, Lowe JK, Tian Y, Horvath S, et al. (2011). Transcriptomic analysis of autistic brain reveals convergent molecular pathology. Nature 474:380-384. doi:10.1038/nature10110

Details

Differential expression was assessed with SAM (Significance Analysis of Microarrays) at FDR < 0.05 and fold change > 1.3.

Examples

data(dataset.s1)
lengths(dataset.s1)
#>   up.regulated down.regulated 
#>            234            229
